correctness.rationale: The gradient forces Q≠0 and λ²=1 at any simultaneous zero, and the two excluded values have explicit singular points. The Z=1 translations fix ξ=y²−2x and η=y⁷−y; the extension is of degree seven, with only one fixed point at infinity. The quotient polynomial and its derivative have a common root only when λ²=1. The quotient Cartier coefficient matrix is diagonal with entries 3a, a³−a, 3a for a=−2λ, so stable rank is ordinary rank on each line; Deuring–Shafarevich multiplies that rank by seven for the parent. Independently multiplying the defining equation six times in the sparse polynomial ring over F₇ and applying the stated residue exponents gave eleven identical row/column support blocks, four determinants λ, four −λ²(λ²−2), and three −λ³(λ²−2). At zero every entry vanishes; at ±3 the two-block entries and three-block two-minors certify a total rank of 14. Hence the exact normalized determinant, divisor and a-numbers follow over any algebraically closed characteristic-seven field, not by extrapolating prime-field samples.
